BitMine adds 12,532 ETH, says buying largely complete

BitMine said it acquired 12,532 ETH over the past week, bringing total holdings to 6,028,946 ETH, or about 4.9% of Ethereum’s 122.1 million supply. The company said it is 99% of the way toward its 5% accumulation target, with 5.07 million ETH currently staked. In its forward-looking disclosures, BitMine also noted management’s statement that the company is “largely finished buying ETH,” suggesting future purchases may slow as it approaches the target. — link

Strategy buys 250 BTC, spends $192M on STRC buybacks

Strategy said it acquired 250 BTC for $21.5 million at an average price of $86,194 between October 5 and 11, bringing total holdings to 848,250 BTC at an aggregate cost of about $64.0 billion. The company also repurchased 1.93 million STRC shares for $192.4 million over the same period. The bitcoin purchase was funded mainly with $21.0 million in proceeds from MSTR share sales, while USD cash stood at $640.5 million and the USD Reserve at $4.88 billion as of October 11. — link

Morgan Stanley pushes tokenized equity support to Q1 2027

According to The Block, Morgan Stanley now expects to support tokenized equities on its alternative trading system in Q1 2027, later than its previous H2 2026 timeline, digital asset strategy head Amy Oldenburg said. She said the bank is still preparing the required infrastructure, while client demand remains limited because tokenized equity products are not yet widely available. Oldenburg also said she expects the tokenized RWA market to reach $3 trillion to $10 trillion by 2030. — link

Singapore Gulf Bank expands USD payments via BNY 24/7 service

Singapore Gulf Bank said it has expanded USD payment access through BNY’s 24/7 USD Book Transfers service, allowing eligible payments to settle outside standard U.S. banking hours, including weekends and public holidays. The service can be used for account funding, payables and time-sensitive cross-border treasury transactions. — link
